items.title: Hyper-realistic cinematic conversion prompt for nano-banana-pro
items.prompt: Core Requirement: Convert all elements in the reference image—including characters, scenes, props, and environment—into ultra-realistic, live-action settings, resembling actual on-set movie stills. Character Conversion: Strictly retain the original character's hairstyle, clothing, expression, facial features, body movements, and overall temperament, converting them into a real actor's image. Scene Conversion: • Restore the comic/illustration scene to a real, physically shootable space • All props, furniture, and architecture must be real set construction or real location shooting • Realistic material texture: fabric folds, wood grain texture, metal reflections, wall texture • Rich environmental details: dust, signs of wear, everyday life details • Spatial perspective and light/shadow must conform to physical laws Photography Style: Cinematic live-action photography • Deep depth of field composition, with everything clear from foreground to background • Film texture, soft grain, and rich color layering • Dramatic light and shadow contrast: warm tungsten working lights vs. cool natural twilight • Subject prominence while retaining environmental narrative • Scene art and photography comparable to 'Blade Runner' or 'The Grand Budapest Hotel' Technical Specifications: • Film Stock: Kodak Vision3 500T (cinematic photography standard) • Applicable Scenes: Night scenes, low light environments, indoor tungsten lighting • Aperture: f/8–f/11 (deep depth of field, entire frame clear) • Focal Length: 35mm–50mm (standard cinematic perspective) • Resolution: 4K cinema or higher • Color: Warm, saturated tungsten color temperature, retaining detail in shadows • Lighting Design: Three-point lighting or natural light combined to create cinematic light and shadow layers Scene Art Requirements: • Real set construction or location shooting, avoiding the feel of CG synthesis • Prop placement conforms to the character's background and era setting • Spatial design with depth and a sense of life • Environmental elements like walls, floors, and ceilings must have realistic texture • Background characters (if any) must also be real actors, avoiding blurring Negative Prompts (Strictly Avoid): • Blurred background, shallow depth of field, bokeh, out-of-focus • Cartoon, anime, illustration style, hand-drawn texture, CG rendering feel • Flat composition, lack of spatial depth • Fake sets, green screen artifacts, digital backgrounds • Facial deformation, disproportionate scaling, AI generation artifacts • Low quality, digital noise, pixelation, excessive sharpening • Overexposed strong light, plastic texture, excessive digital post-processing • Floating props, physical implausibility, material texture mapping feel • Empty background, lack of detail, monotonous environment Reference Style: Masterpieces of cinematic photography - the live-action aesthetic of Roger Deakins, Emmanuel Lubezki, Hoyte van Hoytema.

items.prompt: Create a photorealistic portrait of a young woman with fair skin and a warm natural complexion, subtle freckles, light-colored eyes, and long {argument name="hair color" default="copper-red"} hair gathered into a high, slightly tousled ponytail. A few loose strands frame her face naturally. Her expression is soft and thoughtful, with a relaxed gaze directed toward the camera and a subtle, understated smile. She is positioned beside a large window, turned slightly sideways toward the camera, with one hand gently raised near her face and the other resting naturally along her side. Her posture is relaxed and candid, conveying the feeling of an authentic lifestyle photograph. She is wearing a fitted {argument name="top color" default="deep-red"} short-sleeve top with comfortable {argument name="bottoms" default="light-gray"} casual shorts. Keep the outfit simple, tasteful, contemporary, and natural. Add only minimal understated jewelry, such as a thin bracelet, with no distracting accessories. The setting is a cozy bedroom with a dark charcoal wall, a neatly arranged bed partially visible in the background, a few everyday personal items on a bedside surface, and a tall bright window on the right side of the frame. Soft daylight enters through the window, illuminating her face and hair while creating gentle shadows toward the darker interior. Use realistic ambient room light, subtle window reflections, natural tonal falloff, and a calm intimate atmosphere. Photographed with an 85mm portrait lens, natural perspective, shallow depth of field, soft window light, realistic skin texture, finely detailed individual hair strands, authentic fabric texture, accurate anatomy, crisp focus on the eyes and face, gentle background blur, balanced exposure, cinematic but natural color grading, warm neutral tones, soft contrast, high dynamic range, professional lifestyle photography, subtle film grain, photorealistic detail, vertical composition, candid editorial aesthetic.

items.title: Formal Menswear Coastal Editorial
items.prompt: A {argument name="subject clothing" default="handsome man in a sharp, pitch-black double-breasted suit layered over a crisp white shirt"} stands perfectly centered in a medium-scale shot, exuding a sophisticated menswear aesthetic in a sharp, pitch-black double-breasted suit layered over a crisp white shirt with a defined V-neckline and a stark black tie. His posture is upright with level shoulders, facing the camera directly, while his head is turned sharply to the left in a strict profile. His sleek, slicked-back hair reflects the intense light, and vintage sunglasses obscure his eyes as he looks away with a serious, deliberately posed expression, his mouth resting in a closed, neutral line. Both of his hands are tucked away, resting relaxed in his suit pockets as he stands isolated against a {argument name="background" default="deeply spacious, minimal coastal background"}. The top and midground are dominated by a pristine, sky blue expanse completely devoid of clouds, meeting a dark ocean blue at the bottom of the frame that is subtly textured with gentle waves along a perfectly clear horizon line. The scene conveys a confident, formal isolation driven by {argument name="lighting style" default="harsh, highly directional natural sunlight striking from the top right"}. This bright, hard light establishes a dramatic, cool, and high-contrast color palette, casting deep black, harshly defined short shadows directly under his chin, beneath his nose, and across the left side of his face. Conversely, crisp specular highlights are meticulously preserved on the right side of his face, his hair, and his right shoulder, with absolutely no ambient fill to soften the intense blacks and vibrant blues. Captured on an 85mm lens as a realistic digital editorial photograph from a straight-on perspective, the tack-sharp image features a medium depth of field with zero grain, utilizing camera settings of ISO 100, f/5.6, and 1/1000s. The classic fashion photography influence is finalized by post-processing that applies a high contrast curve, a blue channel saturation boost, and crisp sharpening to highlight the subtle warm skin tones, with the entire composition gracefully framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
